text:
maria: onboarding Dedicated customer - getting SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED when going through corporate proxy + custom CA. local sample works, k8s fails (python async sdk).

aj: are you using REDWOOD_BASE_URL or passing base_url? any proxy envs set?

maria: passing base_url. snippet:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
  c = AsyncClient(base_url=\"https://dedicated.example.com\", api_key=\"...\", proxy=\"http://10.0.0.1:3128\", ca_bundle=\"/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem\")
  await c.generate(\"hi\")
```
fails on TLS handshake despite REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/SSL_CERT_FILE set.

samir: aiohttp doesn't always respect REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE; pass an ssl.SSLContext via connector_args or create one from SSL_CERT_FILE. also intercepting proxies require trusting the proxy CA.

maria: example?

samir:
```python
import ssl
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(..., connector_args={'ssl': ssl_ctx, 'force_http1': True})
```
note: connector_args currently lacks typed support and docs.

olivia: mypy complains. propose adding truststore_path param and typing connector_args: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]].

aj: also watch auth retry: token refresh went through proxy without ssl context -> 401/502 and retry loop for some customers. need to reuse ssl context for refresh calls.

maria: workaround ssl_ctx + force http1 fixed generation. filing repro + logs.

devx-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/4729 — \"py-sdk: truststore_path param + ensure ssl context reuse on refresh retries\" (assigned aj).

samir: i'll PR aiohttp helper to read SSL_CERT_FILE and auto-create ssl.SSLContext when not provided. also add onprem example with k8s initContainer to update OS truststore.

olivia: i'll follow up with typing PR.

maria: thanks, will keep customer updated and linked internal doc in docs/onboarding/dedicated-proxy.md. :thumbsup:
